description: This script conducts performance testing and comparison of different regex engines used by git-grep, including setting up environments, executing tests across various patterns and engines, and comparing output to verify consistency.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Runs performance tests on a large repository to evaluate regex engine performance.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Prepares the working tree for testing.

methods.name: test_set_prereq
methods.description: Sets a prerequisite for subsequent tests based on environment or conditions.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if certain prerequisites or conditions are met before running tests.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Executes performance test commands with specified options.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two output files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful completion.
